ECA_REQUEST_ALLOWED
Description
This event is fired when ECA plugin successfully authenticates and is
about to forward the request up the chain. Since NTLM is
authenticating the flow, the subsequent requests within the flow fired
the same event as well.
Examples
when
ECA_REQUEST_ALLOWED
{
log
local0.
"username:     [ECA::username]"
log
local0.
"domainname: [ECA::domainname]"
log
local0.
"hostname:     [ECA::client_machine_name]"
log
local0.
"status:          [ECA::status]"
}
